item.title: THE QUIETEST PLACE ON EARTH TURNS TEN — We Lost The Sea
item.description: On the 1st of December 2012, we released our second record “The Quietest Place on Earth” with a show at ‘The Roxbury’, a 100-capacity room in the Sydney suburb of Glebe. We had a new vigour with the recent addition of Matt Harvey on guitar following the departure of two founding members.

item.title: EUROPE 2022 TOUR WRAP POST — We Lost The Sea
item.description: It’s been two weeks since we played the last show of our tour to a full room in London. It’s also taken some processing to fully grasp the immensity of what has become our biggest and best tour we’ve ever done.

item.title: MONO AT THE MANNING — We Lost The Sea
item.description: It will be an honour to be sharing the stage again with MONO (Japan) in March.

item.title: T&D IN EUROPE - PART 2 — We Lost The Sea
item.description: You completely blew us away with your passion last November. Our heads are still ringing, literally! We’re on a mission back there in May with fervour and renewed energy for part two. We visit loads of new places, return to a few of our favourites and finish large at Dunk!Festival.

item.title: END OF AN ERA — We Lost The Sea
item.description: Mark and Nathaniel started We Lost The Sea in a shitty rehearsal room in the outskirts of Western Sydney in 2007 and he’s been a massive part of our sound…

item.title: EUROPE IS A WRAP (AGAIN) — We Lost The Sea
item.description: Triumph & Disaster Europe part 2 is done. Phenomenal experiences. Finishing with MONO (Japan) joining us on stage Dunk!festival was a life highlight.

item.title: HERE COME THE ROMANS (AND BOTCH) — We Lost The Sea
item.description: If you told us a lifetime ago that we’d be opening for Botch one day in the distant future, we would have probably laughed.

item.title: APRIL SHOWS AND OTHER THINGS — We Lost The Sea
item.description: We’re coming out of the caves to play a couple of shows. We’ve been working solidly on new material and will be playing some of it live for you in April.

item.title: EVERYTHING HERE IS BLACK AND BLINDING — We Lost The Sea
item.description: This is technically We Lost The Sea’s first proper music video. It’s always been a challenge to try and make videos for songs as long as we write.

item.title: ‘A SINGLE FLOWER’ IS OUT NOW — We Lost The Sea
item.description: It’s release day, always a very special day. After 5 years in the works, the sun is now shining on this black record.
